scientific_integrity: The infinite assertion is proved structurally, not extrapolated from finite verification; prior permutation-only and broader-cycle involution results are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only the rank-n-minus-one Green class of O_n is covered, for n>=2; no entire-monoid matching or other ranks are claimed. No independent review; unindexed prior pairings remain possible.
title: An idempotent-fixing involution matching on the co-rank-one class of isotone maps
